attr.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
attr.desc: Native AArch64 Linux port of the Android game library.
attr.inst: Requires the user's official arm64-v8a GSG Android package v2.11.311. Extract libGame.so into ports/gtasa/gtasa/ and merge the APK and Play Asset Delivery assets into the same directory. This download contains only the Linux port runtime and does not include proprietary game data.
